gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-tai-viet: Athletic and stretched out, Tourney cuts every stroke to a single width and spreads its words wide. Noto Sans Tai Viet follows with short ascenders and a tall x-height, its terminals pulled back from each curve.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-tamil-supplemen: Bold, bulky and stretched wide, Tourney sketches every letter with one unpressed pencil width. Noto Sans Tamil Supplement tucks round, parenthesis-like forms into a tall middle band, giving the heading a stocky, grounded partner.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-tangsa: Chunky, wide and wire-smooth up top, Tourney means business. Tourney is best at grabbing attention, while Noto Sans Tangsa is best at welcoming the eye with wide round openings and short ascenders.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-tc: Athletic and bulky, with rope-thick strokes throughout. Tourney carries the weight, while Noto Sans TC lets its large counters and outward-opening curves give the heading some space to breathe.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-tifinagh: Bold, stretched Tourney words carry rope-heavy curves. Noto Sans Tifinagh then reads in rounded, inflated bowls that fill the line, so extended reading feels open and inviting rather than stiff.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-tirhuta: One constant stroke width runs through every Tourney letter. Noto Sans Tirhuta settles in beneath it with cut-back terminals and a dominant x-height, so extended reading feels spacious and light.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-traditional-nushu: Tourney draws its lines with zero modulation, top to bottom. Noto Traditional Nushu brings a broad-nibbed pen stroke that never curls shut, with bowls filling the line, so reading feels warm and unhurried.
gen-tourney-gf-onest: Heavy and stretched, Tourney shouts in a single width, while Onest keeps short ascenders above big bowls and a gentle monotone line. Loud meets gentle, and both commit fully.
gen-tourney-gf-oxygen: Contemporary and clean, Oxygen leaves its curves open and unclosed. Tourney, bulky and widely stretched with pencil-line consistency, is the loud one, while Oxygen's lowercase nearly matches its capitals.
gen-tourney-gf-pathway-extreme: Flat line weight, wide spacing, bulky lowercase: that is Tourney. Pathway Extreme brings clear round openings and stubby ascenders next to a big x-height, a sturdy partner for that heft.
